title: TSBHUB
script:
discord.gg/tsbhub <- you buy it here.
Show case : https://www.youtube.com/@TSBHUB
features:
Wild Horse Islands - Features
More features will be added!


Tab 1 Auto Farm {

🐴Horse Teleport 
It Teleports you to horses on 3 different islands.

🐴Auto Clicker
Clicks & Avoids guis

🐴Auto Equip
Auto equips your lasso

🐴Auto Train & Auto Walk
Auto trains your horse and is used for receipts farming; auto walk is used with it and does what it says.

🐴Auto Sell horses
Sells horses, does not sell rare&locked horses!
There's a sell timer & delay, so the game does not "overload".

🐴Unlock Crafting & No Cooldown Lasso & Expand Lasso Radius
Unlock Crafting unlocks every lasso you can craft. There is no cooldown. You can throw the lasso multiple times without getting a cooldown, and expand lasso radius expands the radius so u can catch horses that are further away *If its 2 far it won't let you catch it*


👻  Island Teleport
Dropdown with every island and you can choose which one you wish to travel to.
There is also auto teleport to islands, so the horses spawn!

}

Tab 1 Shop & Crafting {

🛒  Shop
Larrys shop but inside the menu dropdown for choosing items, Slider for the amount of the selected item and a button for buying the item!



🔨Crafting
Slider for amount of lassos
Manually craft lassos
Autocraft lassos & settnings for it.

}

Tab 2 Modifications {

⛔Player walkspeed
Changes the players walkspeed

⛔ Player Height
Changes the players height

⛔Horse Height
Changes the horse's height

⛔Horse Walkspeed
Changes the horse's walkspeed

⛔ Horse noclip
You can walk trough buildings&alot of stuff

}

Tab 2 Misc {

⚙️Force Reset
No cooldown reset



⚙️ Switch Server
Switches server.



⚙️ Kick if staff is on the server
Checks existing & joining players user-ids and if it's a staff's user-id, then the script kicks you.



⚙️ Anti Afk
Disables AFK so you won't get kicked for inactivity.

}




 built-in features "Always Active"

⚡ Anti-void
You won't fall into the void.
